name: SSO - Header CDN Filter
description: SSO CDN filter for the header variant. Verifies HS256 session tokens on every request, redirects unauthenticated users, and injects x-sso-* identity headers upstream.

params.name: SESSION_SECRET
params.descr: Random 32-byte base64url string. Signs OAuth/SAML flow cookies in all variants; also signs HS256 session tokens in gate-only and header variants — so the CDN filter needs the same value in those variants.

params.name: SSO_AUDIENCE
params.descr: Token audience claim (e.g. https://app.example.com). The filter rejects any token whose aud doesn't match. Must be identical across both apps — mismatch causes all requests to redirect to login.

params.name: SSO_ISSUER
params.descr: Token issuer claim. Validated only when set on both apps. If set, must be identical across both apps.

params.name: SESSION_COOKIE
params.descr: Name of the cookie carrying the session token. Default: sso_session. Must be identical across both apps — mismatch means the filter never sees the cookie the auth-app sets.

params.name: AUTH_PREFIX
params.descr: Path prefix the CDN filter bypasses so the login flow isn't gated. Default: /auth. Must align with the CDN rule that routes this prefix to the auth-app.

params.name: LOGIN_PAGE_URL
params.descr: Where the filter redirects unauthenticated users. Default: AUTH_PREFIX/ (the built-in provider chooser). Only set this to override with a custom login page.
